name: ingredient-convert
description: Convert cups, tbsp, tsp, ml, fl oz, grams and ounces for 30+ ingredients using real densities.
long_description: Convert a cooking ingredient amount between cups, tablespoons, teaspoons, milliliters, fluid ounces, grams and ounces using a per-ingredient density table (30+ ingredients, sourced). Includes recipe scaling with friendly fractions, bulk conversion, fraction/decimal helpers and a most-googled conversions lookup. All local, deterministic, no network.
